entries.title: Sources: the FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its NCIC database, which is used by law enforcement to share info on warrants and background checks (Evan Perez/CNN)
Oracle says it has secured funding for its infrastructure contract with OpenAI and "any further private discussions with vendors are just additional options" (@oracle)
Nasdaq 100 fell 5.6% on Friday, taking its loss for the week to 10.4%, its worst run in more than six years, amid fears of a slowdown in the AI investment boom (George Steer/Financial Times)
Sources: Wonder is exploring a sale of Grubhub, which it bought in 2024 for $650M; bankers have been in contact with Walmart, Target, Kroger and other retailers (Wall Street Journal)
Sources: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars at a ~$225B valuation, after closing a $5B round at a $190B valuation in August (Wall Street Journal)
Cursor tells lawmakers it is considering phasing out Chinese open-weight AI models due to "geopolitical risk"; Cursor's Composer 2 was built on Kimi K2.5 (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)
Sources: hackers breached the US Department of Agriculture's system that facilitates payments to farmers this week (Julia Ainsley/NBC News)
Artificial Analysis says Inkling 2 Mini, with 5.4B active parameters, matches Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) on its Intelligence Index with ~5x fewer active parameters (Artificial Analysis)
Sources: Cognition is considering raising $2B or more at a $75B valuation, after raising over $3B in 2026 so far, including $2B at a $48B valuation in September (Rebecca Torrence/Bloomberg)
Many longtime Etsy sellers say they are leaving after Etsy updated its terms to say Etsy and its third-party partners can use sellers' content for AI training (Reggie Ugwu/New York Times)
Sources: CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler, which would create a cybersecurity company with a combined market cap of ~$265B; ZS jumps 15%+ after hours (Bloomberg)
TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)
Bitcoin falls to $57,000, its lowest level in over two years; it has lost more than half its value since reaching a peak above $126,000 in October 2025 (Bloomberg)
Sources: the US SEC is probing Nvidia's accounting practices; last year, Nvidia changed how it reports revenue, removing Singapore from geographical breakdowns (Reuters)
Sources: Nvidia board's main reason for ousting Jensen Huang was his "lying" and "lack of candor" from October 2025 until this fall over the Alice Huang affair (Wired)
